message: The other day, I finally got around to replacing the batteries in our smoke alarms—after putting it off for way too long. I swear, when I heard that chirp of a fresh battery, it felt like I was winning at adulting. It’s funny how the little things can give you that smug 'I told you so' moment, right? Just a gentle reminder to check those alarms and have a fire escape plan; it’s worth it for the peace of mind.
